common.loginBanner: Log in again to pick up your saved courses

main.heroTitle:
What kind of trip
should we plan?
main.heroSubtitle:
Courses are built in Injae, Hongcheon and Pyeongchang.
No login needed to get started.
main.freeTextLabel: What kind of trip do you want?
main.freeTextPlaceholder:
e.g. Walking forest trails, quiet exhibitions,
nothing too packed
main.freeTextHint: The more you write, the better we can match your taste.
main.regionHintDefault: Choose one, or we'll find the right fit
main.regionHintAuto: We'll pick a region based on what you write, then split it across your days
main.regionHintNoText: Write what kind of trip you want and we'll pick a region for you
main.regionHintTooMany: You can't pick more regions than days ({count} regions need at least {count} days)
main.regionFootnote: Gangwon has 18 counties/cities in total — Injae, Hongcheon and Pyeongchang are open for now.
main.dateDaysTag: {count, plural, one {# day trip} other {# day trip}}
main.checklistIncomplete: {count, plural, one {# required field is still empty} other {# required fields are still empty}}

loading.titleAuto:
Finding the region
that fits you
loading.subtitle: Usually done within a few seconds.

result.emptyDayTitle: Not enough recommendations for this day
result.emptyDayBody: We couldn't find enough spots in {region} for {date}. Try shortening the trip by a day, or choose a different area.
result.emptyDayFooterNote: You can still save a course with an empty day.
result.saveHint: Save it and we'll suggest what to change first if things shift during your trip.
result.mapFallbackBody: Your course is unaffected — check the order in the list below, or try reloading the map.
result.errorServerBody: Please try again in a moment. What you entered is still here.
result.errorServerHint: If this keeps happening, please try again a little later.
result.errorNoCandidateBody: Try a longer trip, or describe what you want differently.
result.errorNoCandidateHint: We'll keep your region and travel-party choices as they are
result.watchingTitle: We're watching the weather and traffic
result.watchingSubtitle: We'll let you know if anything changes

save.loginPromptTitle:
Log in to save
this course
save.loginPromptBody: Once saved, we'll suggest what to change first if it rains or traffic gets bad during your trip.
save.loginPromptKeepSuffix: you just made stays right here even without logging in.
save.loginSubtitle:
Start right away with your Google account.
No separate sign-up needed.
save.loginPopupHint: This opens a Google sign-in window
save.loginSaveHint: Logging in saves this course. It won't disappear even if this fails.
save.loginTerms: Continuing means you agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
save.retryBody: The popup may have been blocked. Tap the button below to open it again.
save.notifyTitle:
Notify you even when
you're on another tab?
save.notifyBody: We'll only send something when weather or traffic actually changes.
save.notifyFootnote: We only ask this once, right after you save a course

care.title: Travel Care guide
care.subtitleWithLocation: Showing places closest to where you are.
care.loginNote: You can view this anytime, no login needed.
care.noLocationNote: No location access — showing {region} order instead
care.nameFootnote: Tap a facility to see its location and directions on the map. Names are kept exactly as they appear in public emergency medical / health data.
care.permissionBody: We'll sort hospitals and health centers by distance from where you are right now.
care.permissionPrivacy: Your location is only used while this screen is open — never sent or stored.
